title: Users
lead: The people who can sign in to this installation.
ownerCannotBeDisabled: The installation owner can't be disabled.
ownerCannotBeDeleted: The installation owner can't be deleted.
actionFailed: Could not change this user. Reload the page and try again.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing the last loaded users.

create.title: Add user
create.description: They sign in with this user name and password. You can reset the password later.

disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.message_one: {{name}} is signed out on every device and can't sign in until enabled again. Their active access token is revoked: scripts and AI assistants that use it are refused, and Enable won't bring it back.
disable.message_other: {{name}} is signed out on every device and can't sign in until enabled again. Their {{value}} active access tokens are revoked: scripts and AI assistants that use them are refused, and Enable won't bring them back.

reset.title: Reset the password of {{name}}
reset.description: {{name}} is signed out on every device and signs in again with the new password. Their access tokens stop working.
reset.descriptionSelf: Your other devices are signed out. This one stays signed in. Your access tokens stop working.

revokeTokens.title: Revoke the access tokens of {{name}}?
revokeTokens.message_one: The active access token of {{name}} stops working at once: scripts and AI assistants that use it are refused. This can't be undone.
revokeTokens.message_other: The {{value}} active access tokens of {{name}} stop working at once: scripts and AI assistants that use them are refused. This can't be undone.
revokeTokens.done: The access tokens of {{name}} were revoked.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.message: {{name}} can no longer sign in and is signed out everywhere. This can't be undone.
